# Kookerella.FsOpenXmlDsl

> A typesafe F# DSL for building and reading Excel workbooks (.xlsx/.xlsm), interpreted
> into calls against the DocumentFormat.OpenXml SDK. Unlike write-only Excel generators,
> it round-trips (read a file back into the same immutable model) and can regenerate
> equivalent F# source from a loaded workbook via built-in code generation.

NuGet package ID: `Kookerella.FsOpenXmlDsl`. Root namespace: `Kookerella.FsOpenXmlDsl`
(internals live under `Kookerella.FsOpenXmlDsl.Interpreter`, not part of the public API).
Target framework: net10.0. License: MIT. Language: F# only — there is no C# port yet, and
the DSL's ergonomics (discriminated unions, `open type SheetDsl`, pipe-friendly builders)
are F#-idiomatic; a C# caller can still reference the assembly directly but will find the
API considerably less pleasant than an F# caller would.

## Core model

- `Workbook = { Sheets: Worksheet list; DefinedNames: DefinedNameEntry list; Protection: WorkbookProtection option; VbaProject: byte[] option }`
- `Worksheet` holds a sparse `Cell list` plus per-feature fields (`Tables`, `Charts`,
  `Images`, `PivotTables`, `SparklineGroups`, `ConditionalFormats`, `DataValidations`,
  `Hyperlinks`, `Comments`, `PageSetup`, `Protection`, `MergedRanges`, `FreezePane`,
  `AutoFilter`, `ColumnProps`, `RowProps`).
- `CellValue = Empty | Text of string | Number of float | Boolean of bool | Date of DateTime | Formula of expression: string * cachedValue: float option`
- `CellRef` is a zero-based `{ Row: int; Col: int }`; convert via `CellRef.ofA1 "B3"` / `CellRef.toA1 ref`.

## Entry points (`Kookerella.FsOpenXmlDsl.Api`, module `Workbook`)

- `Workbook.save (path: string) (wb: Workbook) : unit`
- `Workbook.saveToStream (stream: Stream) (wb: Workbook) : unit`
- `Workbook.load (path: string) : Workbook`
- `Workbook.loadFromStream (stream: Stream) : Workbook`
- `Workbook.generateScript (referenceLines: string list) (outputFileName: string) (wb: Workbook) : string`
  — renders `wb` as a self-contained `.fsx` that rebuilds an equivalent file when run via `dotnet fsi`.

## Building a workbook (the common path)

```fsharp
open Kookerella.FsOpenXmlDsl
open type Kookerella.FsOpenXmlDsl.SheetDsl

let data =
    sheet "Sheet1"
        [ row [ cell (Text "Name"); cell (Text "Amount") ]
          row [ cell (Text "Widgets"); cell (Number 42.5) ] ]

workbook [ data ] |> Workbook.save "out.xlsx"
```

`cell`/`row` are members on `SheetDsl` (brought into scope with `open type`, since plain
F# `let` functions can't have optional parameters) with optional `?col`/`?style`/`?index`.
`sheet` folds a `SheetItem list` (rows, `Table`, `EmbeddedChart`, `EmbeddedImage`,
`EmbeddedPivotTable`, `SparklineGroup`, `Protect`, `PageSetup`, `Freeze`, `ColumnWidth`,
`autoFilter`, `conditionalFormat`, `dataValidation`, `hyperlink`, `comment`) into a
`Worksheet`. `withDefinedNames`/`withProtection`/`withVbaProject` are pipe-friendly
`Workbook -> Workbook` helpers for the workbook-level (not per-sheet) features.

## Load-bearing gotchas — read before generating code against this library

- **No formula evaluation engine exists.** `Formula(expression, cachedValue)` only ever
  shows `cachedValue` until something else computes a real one. Real Excel recalculates on
  open, so `cachedValue = None` is fine only if a human opens the result in Excel first.
  For any headless pipeline (PDF conversion, another automated reader, anything that never
  opens the file in Excel) always pass the real computed result as `cachedValue` — the
  caller almost certainly already has the number that fed into the formula.
- **Format support is `.xlsx`/`.xlsm` only.** No legacy binary `.xls`, no `.xlsb`, and no
  password-encrypted-to-open workbooks (those aren't plain ZIP/OPC packages; opening one
  throws before this library's own code runs at all).
- **`Reader.load` is lossy for anything not modeled**, by design: it drops OOXML features
  outside the DSL's scope rather than partially/incorrectly representing them. See
  MAPPING.md's "Known gaps" section before assuming a foreign file's feature round-trips.
- **VBA/macros are opaque bytes only** (`Workbook.VbaProject: byte[] option`) — there is no
  API to author, edit, or list macro source. Attach an existing `vbaProject.bin`'s raw
  bytes; save with an `.xlsm` path.
- **Pivot tables perform real aggregation** (Sum/Count/CountNumbers/Average/Min/Max) but
  are deliberately capped at one row field, at most one column field, and one value field —
  see MAPPING.md before assuming a richer pivot table shape works.
- **API is pre-1.0 (`0.1.0`)** — expect breaking changes between minor versions until a
  1.0 is tagged.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md) — full quick-start with runnable examples for every feature
  (formulas, tables, charts, images, pivot tables, sparklines, VBA, conditional formatting,
  data validation, protection, print settings, defined names, code generation).
- [MAPPING.md](MAPPING.md) — the authoritative list of what maps 1:1 onto SpreadsheetML,
  what's approximated, and what isn't modeled at all. Consult this before claiming this
  library supports a specific OOXML feature.
- `tests/Kookerella.FsOpenXmlDsl.Tests/Examples/` — one real, openable example workbook
  (plus the F# script that regenerates it) per feature; a working reference implementation
  for any feature described above.
